content.definition: Other Comprehensive Bases of Accounting (OCBOA) = Comprehensive basis other than GAAP
content.when_used: Private companies, specific-purpose financial statements, contractual requirements, regulatory filings

cash_basis.recognition: Revenue when cash received, expenses when cash paid

modified_cash_basis.hybrid: Primarily cash basis with some accruals (e.g., depreciation, long-term debt)
modified_cash_basis.example: Cash basis + depreciate fixed assets + accrue long-term liabilities
modified_cash_basis.flexibility: Can customize (but must be comprehensive and consistently applied)

tax_basis.when_used: Partnership financial statements, S corporations, compliance with tax requirements
tax_basis.example: Use tax depreciation (MACRS), tax inventory methods

contractual_basis.example: Loan agreement requires cash-basis financial statements

expenses.accrual: When incurred (matched to revenue or consumed)

financial_statement_titles.must_distinguish: Cannot title statements as 'Balance Sheet' or 'Income Statement' (those imply GAAP)
financial_statement_titles.cash_basis_titles: Statement of Assets and Liabilities Arising from Cash Transactions, Statement of Revenue Collected and Expenses Paid
financial_statement_titles.tax_basis_titles: Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Equity - Income Tax Basis

disclosure_requirements.basis_description: Disclose basis of accounting used and how it differs from GAAP
disclosure_requirements.material_differences: Describe material differences from GAAP (qualitatively or quantitatively)
disclosure_requirements.consistency: Disclose if basis changed from prior period

audit_reporting.special_purpose_framework: Auditor issues special purpose framework opinion (not GAAP opinion)
audit_reporting.emphasis_of_matter: Audit report emphasizes financial statements prepared using special purpose framework
audit_reporting.distribution: May restrict distribution if prepared for specific purpose

gaap_vs_ocboa.gaap: Required for public companies, provides most comprehensive information
gaap_vs_ocboa.ocboa: Allowed for private companies, simpler, may meet specific needs (tax, regulatory, contractual)
gaap_vs_ocboa.choice: Entity chooses basis (unless required by contract/regulator)

cpa_exam_tips: OCBOA = Other comprehensive basis of accounting (not GAAP)
Types: Cash, modified cash, tax, regulatory, contractual
Cash basis: Revenue when received, expenses when paid. No accruals.
Tax basis: Follow IRS rules (depreciation, inventory, etc.)
Financial statement titles must differ from GAAP (can't say 'Balance Sheet' if cash basis)
Disclose basis used and differences from GAAP

key_points: OCBOA: Comprehensive basis other than GAAP (cash, modified cash, tax, regulatory, contractual)
Cash basis: Revenue when received, expenses when paid. No accruals.
Modified cash: Cash basis with selected accruals (flexible)
Financial statement titles must distinguish from GAAP
Disclose basis and differences from GAAP
